fingerprinted_terminal_input_manifest.record_source: The frozen provenance snapshot supplies logical_path, sha256 and size_bytes for terminal translation_contextual_v1 REVIEWER inputs at each task's terminal cycle.

join.cardinality: Every selected identity must occur exactly once in the source frame, evidence packets, canonical membership and terminal rows. Any duplicate fails even when values are identical.
join.source_binding: terminal source must byte-equal frame source and sha256(raw source UTF-8) must equal both frame and membership source_sha256
join.target_binding: sha256(raw target UTF-8) must equal canonical membership target_sha256; no Unicode, whitespace, newline or escape normalization is allowed
join.terminal_input_policy: Verify all 58 frozen terminal files before extracting any selected target, including terminal files not used by the selected 120 items.
join.terminal_dispatch_rule: Use REVIEWER/translation_contextual_v1 dispatches with input_path. If any have numeric cycle, use every dispatch at the maximum numeric cycle; otherwise use only the final matching dispatch.
join.production_binding: canonical membership production_translation_commit and provenance snapshot source_repo_head must both equal the frozen production commit
join.presentation_order: Preserve category order Runtime then Narrative and preserve the exact item order within each source-screen category. Never resort after target join.
join.audit_id: V1- plus the one-based presentation ordinal padded to three digits

hashing.raw_string: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of the JavaScript string
hashing.canonical_json: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(value) with no trailing newline
hashing.file: UTF-8 pretty JSON with two-space indentation and one trailing LF
hashing.terminal_manifest_record: logical_path NUL sha256 NUL size_bytes LF, sorted by logical_path
hashing.binding_manifest_record: audit_id NUL category NUL task_id NUL original_revision_key NUL source_sha256 NUL target_sha256 NUL membership_sha256 NUL terminal logical_path NUL terminal sha256 NUL terminal size_bytes LF, in presentation order
hashing.target_bound_presentation: Canonical JSON of schema_version plus ordered categories whose items are exactly revision_id, source, target and source_evidence

outputs.sharding: presentation position modulo three; each item appears in exactly one surface shard. A matching context shard is generated later only after the complete surface candidate passes its exact schema and frozen byte-hash gate.

required_gates: production commit matches membership and snapshot
58 terminal fingerprints and the terminal manifest match
120 selected identities and 120 evidence packets are exact and unique
all four join sides have cardinality one
all source and target hashes match
Runtime and Narrative remain 60 items each in frozen order
three surface shards are a disjoint complete 40-item partition and no context shard exists at bind time
each released context shard binds one exact-schema 40-item surface candidate and its pre-frozen byte SHA-256
all output objects have exact field sets
model and network call counts remain zero
current_phase_boundary: This contract authorizes implementation and synthetic testing only. It does not authorize reading production target text, generating the real target-bound queue or starting an audit.
